verdict.rationale: Snowflake's first-party "Regulatory compliance" docs include a page for each certification, among them SOC 2 Type II, PCI DSS, SOC 1 Type II, ISO-27001/27017/27018, FedRAMP Moderate/High and CSA STAR. That gives security reviewers documented attestations to work from. Access History views are also documented as facilitating regulatory compliance auditing. Missing for 10: HIPAA attestation evidence (not listed in the pack), independent or hands-on confirmation that the attestation reports can be obtained in practice.
